'''Iain Reid Fettster Mining Inc.''' is a [[Dark]] Clouds and Jabba's Palace list [[Iain Reid]] posted for critique.<ref name="list-45550">[http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/45550.html? swccg-discussion message #45550], [[Iain Reid]] (1 June 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000108232859/http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/45550.html? Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Iain Reid]]
* '''Published:''' 1 June 1998 (swccg-discussion)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace]] (from the card pool)
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Jabba's Palace|JP-D-tatooinejabbaspalace.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Twi'lek Advisor|JP-D-twilekadvisor.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|There Is No Try|Dagobah-D-thereisnotry.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Fettster Mining Inc.
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PJP Fettster Reid DS 1998.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Reid wrote the list at 3–0 and asked whether it was tournament-worthy.

== Strategy ==

Audience Chamber fetches Gailid or Boba Fett. Clouds and palace sites drain. Scanning Crew, Defensive Fire, Monnok and Voyeur slow Mains. Hidden Weapons and Stunning Leader cover battles.
